author: leonclipping
seen: A TikTok profile for a faceless relationship page (@notruthlove). Every post uses the same photo of a couple by the sea. Only the title text changes ("the strict agreements we made before signing a lease", "Rules we made after we almost broke up"), and each post gets about 100K to 775K views. The page never shows a face, and the product is pushed inside the slides.
